patch_description:
The current single-block XX-chain design (score 0.68) has too many parameters (20) and poor parameter efficiency (0.05). Prior two-block designs with CZ chains achieved 0.72 with 14 params by maintaining full parameter sharing.

Following the recommendation to introduce block-specific specialization, we will:
1. Return to the proven CZ-chain architecture (simpler, more efficient than XX)
2. Add a second identical block
3. Use block-specific parameters: block 1 uses ry_1/rz_1, block 2 uses ry_2/rz_2

This allows each deep sandwich (block) to learn different features while maintaining high parameter economy. Expected: ~18 params, better parameter efficiency, improved expressivity beyond uniform design.
